preconditions.description: n is a positive integer within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= n for f_i in f_values)
preconditions.description: Each f(i) is an integer between 1 and n, inclusive.
The input contains exactly n values for f(1), ..., f(n).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.split() and (m := int(stdout.split()[0])) >= 1 and m <= 10**6)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is a valid m within bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and (g_values := list(map(int, stdout.split()[1:1+n]))) and len(g_values) == n and all(1 <= g_i <= m for g_i in g_values)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the second line contains n integers g(1), ..., g(n) where each g(i) is in [1, m].

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and (h_values := list(map(int, stdout.split()[1+n:1+n+m]))) and len(h_values) == m and all(1 <= h_i <= n for h_i in h_values)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the third line contains m integers h(1), ..., h(m) where each h(i) is in [1, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(g_values[h_values[x] - 1] == x for x in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: For all x in [1, m], g(h(x)) = x (injective property).

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(g_values[f_values[x - 1] - 1] == g_values[x - 1] for x in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For all x in [1, n], h(g(x)) = f(x) (functional composition property).
